sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Deterministic validation still prevents freezing because the COMPLETE dependency contract incorrectly lists frameProfileType as required. Preserve the candidate’s current applicability, owner paths, demand <= plasticStrength comparison, common-unit requirement, derived plasticStrength/midspanPlasticCollapseLoad tolerance, conditional ship-owned patchLoad and plasticCollapseMechanism checks, and bottom-load-case orientation rule. Do not add frameProfileType: the verified I2-031 requirement contains no frame-profile obligation, and the supplied registry record grounds that term only in TRF-051.
